checks.description: Stage 4 level consistent with Stage 1 + Stage 3 combined evidence
checks.expected: User impact Level 1 (low severity) consistent with: mostly_mild regime (Stage 1), adequate redistribution (Stage 1), no critical infra (Stage 3), residential suburban geography (Stage 3), 11.54% holes mitigated to 'moderate' zone-level impact only
checks.found: Stage 4 assigns user_impact_level=1 (Minimal), impact_severity=low. Stage 1 confirms: all overload=low, mostly_mild regime, adequate verdict. Stage 3 confirms: no critical infra, residential land use, moderate zone impact limited to 3-pixel southern fringe. Level 1 is consistent with the combined evidence — the sole Level 2 indicator (holes 5-20%) is appropriately offset by the C3 reduction.
checks.note: Cross-stage consistency verified: the Level 1 outcome is the correct synthesis of Stage 1 (adequate redistribution, mostly_mild) + Stage 3 (no critical infra, residential suburban) with C3 applied.

recommendations: No critical failures identified. The assessment result is verified and trustworthy.

The 11.54% coverage hole fraction (3 pixels, southern fringe) should be monitored operationally — if these pixels are later found to contain critical user clusters or infrastructure, a re-run of Stages 3–4 with updated land-use data is recommended.
Consider deploying a temporary cell or boosting USID_41/USID_37 transmit power during the shutdown window to address the southern fringe coverage gap.

V2/V3 role confidence is uniformly 'low' for all USIDs due to small dominant fractions — this is a network topology characteristic, not an analysis defect. Role confidence could be improved with traffic/user count data.
